name: agentdb
description: AgentDB's own standalone MCP server (npx agentdb mcp start) for Claude Code: vector memory, reflexion episodes, skills, causal edges and learning tools, plus a mod that keeps secrets out of memory and refuses destructive admin tools unless enabled. Not the ruflo-agentdb plugin, which reaches AgentDB through ruflo's MCP server; the two can be installed side by side.

mcp_profile.title: MCP tool profile
mcp_profile.description: Sets AGENTDB_MCP_PROFILE: readonly, retrieval, learning or admin. Empty means the server default, learning (reads plus memory writes). admin also exposes agentdb_init, agentdb_delete, agentdb_delete_batch and agentdb_clear_cache; the mod still refuses those unless allow_destructive is on.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Sets AGENTDB_PATH, the database file the server opens. Empty means ./agentdb.db in the directory Claude Code starts the server from.

mcp_allow.title: Extra tools to expose
mcp_allow.description: Sets AGENTDB_MCP_ALLOW: tool names, comma or space separated, added to the profile's list. Empty adds none.

mcp_deny.title: Tools to hide
mcp_deny.description: Sets AGENTDB_MCP_DENY: tool names, comma or space separated, removed whatever the profile says. Empty hides none.

secret_guard.title: Secret write guard
secret_guard.description: enforce (default): refuse AgentDB memory writes that hold what looks like a key, token, password or private key. notify: let them through with a toast. off: no check.

allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive admin tools
allow_destructive.description: Off (default): the mod refuses agentdb_delete, agentdb_delete_batch, agentdb_clear_cache and agentdb_init with reset. On: lets them through (the server only exposes them under the admin profile or when named in mcp_allow).
